name: Theocracy The Or Immediate Government By God
overview: Theocracy, as revealed in Scripture, is the immediate government of God over His people, demonstrated through His direct guidance and authority from the deliverance of Israel out of Egypt until the appointment of kings. God appointed civil and ecclesiastical officers, exercised supreme judgment, and directed national movements, including proclaiming war against Amalek as a divine mandate. The presence of God was visibly manifested over the tabernacle, designed as His royal residence, symbolizing His covenantal relationship and sovereign rule over Israel.
